description.value: The Bella Coola Valley Museum, established in 1963 and housed in a heritage building dating to approximately 1892, documents the human history of the Bella Coola Valley from European contact to 1955. Run by a non-profit society, it offers guided tours, historic videos, a gift shop, and a Historic Walking Tour brochure that touring cyclists could use to explore the town. A companion archives branch provides year-round research access, making it a substantive cultural stop on the remote Highway 20 corridor.

address.value: 269 Alexander MacKenzie Highway, Bella Coola, BC V0T 1C0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the primary evidence source and confirms the museum operates at 269 Highway 20 (the same road as OSM's 'Alexander MacKenzie Highway') with phone 250-799-0021. The website makes no mention of bike parking, washrooms, water access, or any cycling-specific amenities, so all those fields remain null. The OSM name 'Bella Coola Museum' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Bella Coola Valley Museum', and the website's 'Now open for 2022 season' language indicates the website content has not been updated since 2022.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM lists 'Bella Coola Museum' but the website consistently uses 'Bella Coola Valley Museum'. The OSM name should likely be corrected.
Website content appears outdated: the page references 'Now open for 2022 season', suggesting it has not been updated since at least 2022. Amenity details and contact info may be stale.
Address naming discrepancy: OSM uses 'Alexander MacKenzie Highway' while the website uses 'Highway 20'; these are the same road but the difference may affect geocoding or display.
OSM record has no phone number; the website lists 250-799-0021 (seasonal) and 250-982-2130 (Archives) — recommend adding to OSM.
OSM record has no email; the website contact page omits a direct email address as well.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Bella Coola Valley Museum is a legitimate, operational cultural attraction on the Highway 20 cycling corridor — one of BC's most iconic and remote touring routes — and would be a meaningful stop for cycle tourists passing through Bella Coola.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Archives branch (B.C. Central Coast Archives) is located at a separate address — 1961 Hwy 20, Hagensborg, BC — and operates year-round by appointment. This is distinct from the main museum building at 269 Hwy 20.

wow_evidence: Regional museum with real collection in ~1892 heritage building since 1963; heritage-museum band.
blurb: Valley history museum in an 1892 heritage building; guided tours and historic walking-tour brochure.
